summary: Host-local retirement-qualified learner samples conservative resource profiles and brakes pressured admission. Samples persist per execution generation and the estimator reads a bounded trailing window.

replay.detail: One immutable sample row per qualified execution generation is retained, including outside the estimator's trailing window, so replays stay deduplicated.

schema.detail: Local resource_profile_samples_v1 stores host-local sample rows; no graph claim schema changes.

rules.detail: Samples are recorded only in the terminal receipt transaction after confirmed whole-tree retirement; rejected or truncated retirements are not admitted.

compatibility.detail: Host-local store extension only; callers and wire formats unchanged.

downtime.detail: No host deployment or caller cutover is activated by this change.

recovery.detail: Retained sample rows provide permanent replay dedupe; reclamation of rows outside the trailing window remains bounded-debt follow-up.
